name: The Ashenvale Hunt

summary: In Ashenvale, Horde hunters face the ancient forest's three great predators. Senani Thunderheart oversees the trial at Splintertree Post, where hunters track Ursangous, Shadumbra, and Sharptalon to prove their skill.

sections.title: A Tauren Tradition in an Ancient Forest
sections.body: Senani Thunderheart gives the Horde's presence in Ashenvale a different kind of test. While Orcs gather lumber, she sends hunters into the shadowed forest to face its strongest predators. The hunt calls for more than strength: hunters must meet the wilderness with cunning and respect, and learn what they can endure.

sections.title: The Three Great Beasts
sections.body: Three solitary beasts test those who take up the hunt. Ursangous, an immense elder bear, roams near the Talondeep Path. Shadumbra, a cunning nightsaber, stalks the eastern borders near Raynewood Retreat and the Laughing Sisters. South of Splintertree Post, Sharptalon, a fierce hippogryph, wheels above the forest canopy.

faq.answer: Senani Thunderheart, a tauren hunter stationed in Ashenvale, directs the hunt. She challenges Horde travelers to prove their survival skills against the wilderness.

faq.q: What beasts do I need to track down?
faq.answer: Track Ursangous the great bear, Shadumbra the nightsaber, and Sharptalon the hippogryph.
Ursangous roams just west of the Talondeep Path among other wild bears of the forest.
Shadumbra prowls south of Raynewood Retreat, near the road where the dryads called the Laughing Sisters dwell.
Sharptalon ranges south of Splintertree Post, flying over the trees and clearing.

faq.q: Why does Senani Thunderheart send hunters after these beasts?
faq.answer: Senani means the hunt as an honorable trial, not wanton slaughter. Facing the forest's deadliest natural residents should teach hunters about the wilderness and their own strength.

angles.text: As a tauren hunter, tracking Ursangous, Shadumbra, and Sharptalon honors the Earth Mother's creation. The hunt balances respect for nature's ferocity with the honor of the stalk.
As a hunter, you scour wide stretches of forest, read the terrain, and face beasts that can easily overcome an unwary tracker.
As a member of the Horde, you can find a path of martial honor and spiritual connection in Ashenvale, even as the Warsong clear-cut the forest.
